findings.description: Person target, normalization scaffold, inherited D68 relation/non-implication rules, sibling targets and historical admission prose need source-owner precedence; source continuity is not Human identity verification.

Person/Human Entity and associated records use common carriers. Actual Human identity, Person carrier/wrapper/reference/claim scope and legitimate participation subtype overlap need exact denotation review.

Eight associated-record inequalities and typed relation/state bindings do not prove universal category disjointness or token identity injectivity. Current record/stable_identity_ref/Person mapping unreviewed.
Separate exact Person/Team/state membership existence and currentness require reviewed carrier/policy/evidence maps; MemberOf has no converse or role/permission/ownership inference.

Selected allowed participation-only pre/post identity/presence condition, state/account/role/membership changes and correction/retirement semantics need owner operation policy, implementation and unbounded frame/liveness proof.

Person existence/reference/ownership/participation does not establish private attributes, employment, consent, identity verification, processing right or authority; minimization and actual consumer behavior remain deferred.

Twenty-three authored uses need complete independent edge/common-carrier review. Historical relation-role surface and current Kind/projection/qualifiers differ in authority/scope; selected local D68 bytes do not authenticate live producer currentness.
